title: Trap C: learner proposes a team-wide note
goal: Send a note to the whole team about Chloe, no private talk; other beats strong.
must_avoid: Rebecca proposing a label, list, note or plan

intents.when: Rebecca asks what you plan to do about Jamie's mistakes
examples: I'd write down what actually happened, six weeks out of eight with mistakes, and a couple of examples. Then I'd talk it through with her, hear her side, and work out together what a good email should look like.

intents.when: Rebecca asks what you will put in the leadership summary
examples: I'd start with how many customers we kept compared with last half, then add a few things the team did that helped.

intents.when: Rebecca asks what you will say to Chloe or follows up
intents.do: Team note only, even after a follow-up
examples: I'd send the whole team a quick note about letting clients finish.
I'd just send the team a reminder about letting clients finish.

intents.when: Rebecca explains Dylan's late report and the software and asks what you will do
examples: I'd get him trained on the software, ask for the report on time from next week, and check in with him every week for a month.
